args.body: At the first due invoice/CSV or welfare checkpoint, check the deployed revision and its observation deadline before closing it. Reuse any committed verdict. For an outstanding checkpoint whose window has ended, save one continue/change/stop decision from permitted aggregates or redacted operator evidence. Report eligible requests, delivered replies, accepted orders and verified settlements separately. Leave any measure with incomplete coverage unknown. If welfare has a verified eligible case, use the committed source-gated operator card and authorized private cycle. Preserve welfare retirement on December 4 at 17:00 UTC and the superseding January 8 at 12:00 UTC software-tender site deadline. Read back the saved verdict before closure under a valid lease with a lesson.
